tools.name: cap_ls
tools.description: List a folder in the workspace's capability tree. /capabilities holds README.md (the authoring guide), schema.json (the capability.yaml schema) and one folder per capability, custom or packaged. A custom capability's folder shows its open draft if there is one, else its published version. Packaged capabilities are read-only.

path.description: Folder to list, e.g. /capabilities or /capabilities/pgbouncer-health/tasks. Defaults to /capabilities.

reason.description: One short sentence: why you are making this call.

tools.name: cap_read
tools.description: Read a file from the capability tree, whole or by line range. Read /capabilities/README.md before writing your first capability. Always read a file before editing it.

reason.description: One short sentence: why you are making this call.

tools.name: cap_glob
tools.description: Find files in the capability tree by pattern, e.g. /capabilities/*/tasks/*.py or /capabilities/**/capability.yaml.

pattern.description: Glob over full paths; ** matches across folders.

reason.description: One short sentence: why you are making this call.

tools.name: cap_grep
tools.description: Search file contents in the capability tree for a plain substring (not a regex). Use it to find existing capabilities that already check something before writing a new one.

path.description: Only search under this path prefix.

reason.description: One short sentence: why you are making this call.

tools.name: cap_write
tools.description: Create or replace a whole file in a capability's draft (a draft opens automatically). Writing /capabilities/<new-name>/capability.yaml creates a new capability. Prefer cap_edit for changes to an existing file. Returns validation findings with file and line; fix them before testing. Set delete=true to remove a file.

path.description: File path under /capabilities/<name>/: capability.yaml, tasks/**, lib/**, schemas/**, tests/** or README.md.

delete.description: Delete the file instead of writing it.

reason.description: One short sentence: why you are making this call.

tools.name: cap_edit
tools.description: Replace an exact string in a capability draft file. old_string must occur exactly once unless replace_all is true; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. Returns validation findings.

old_string.description: Exact text to replace, copied from cap_read output.

reason.description: One short sentence: why you are making this call.

tools.name: cap_test
tools.description: Run one task of a capability's draft against a real resource and return its outputs, errors and log tail. A passing run is the test evidence publishing needs, for that exact task code. If the run is still going after wait_seconds, call again with run_id to keep waiting.

target.description: The resource to run against: its name or URN. It must match the capability's appliesTo.

inputs.description: Values for the task's runtime inputs.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result. Default 30.

run_id.description: Poll an earlier test run instead of starting a new one.

reason.description: One short sentence: why you are making this call.

tools.name: cap_diff
tools.description: Show pending capability drafts: changed files as unified diffs, validation state, which tasks still need a passing test, and how the resources the capability applies to would change.

path.description: Limit to one capability, e.g. /capabilities/pgbouncer-health. Default: every open draft.

reason.description: One short sentence: why you are making this call.

tools.name: cap_submit
tools.description: Propose a capability draft for publishing. Needs a clean validation and a passing cap_test for every changed task. It does not publish: it shows the person an approval card, and a workspace admin approves it there. After submitting, tell the person to review and approve the card.

reason.description: What this version does and why, in one or two sentences, shown on the approval card.

tools.name: cap_discard
tools.description: Discard a capability's open draft: every change since its published version is dropped. A capability that was never published is removed entirely. Only do this when the person asked for it.

reason.description: One short sentence: why you are making this call.
